## Configuration
1. Set the production callback URL in **Construct Job**. Repository defaults already point to Skip-me-not/horror-video-automation.
2. Select the same **GitHub Actions Token** Header Auth credential on both dispatch nodes.
3. **Daily Schedule** runs at 05:30, 08:30, 11:30 and 14:30 in the workflow timezone.
4. Activate this workflow after testing once. GitHub cron is intentionally disabled to prevent duplicate uploads.

## English horror Shorts\nScheduled runs rotate through the repository's 500-story bank automatically. Webhook jobs may supply an original 180-1100 character English story. Narration sets a 24-59 second final duration. All successful runs upload publicly. Test both manual and scheduled dispatch nodes before activation.
